mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses equity discount rates and boosts forward returns, as lower financing costs improve corporate cash flow valuations in the S&P 500.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns through higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% and payroll growth exceeding 100k persons signals robust labor market conditions that accelerate consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by GDPC1 quarterly growth below 1.5% and HOUST below 1250 thousand units indicates slowing economic momentum, triggering recession fears that depress forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth < 1.5% and HOUST < 1250), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit visibility, causing negative forward returns through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Combined high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal persistent inflationary pressures requiring aggressive monetary tightening, depressing forward returns through higher real rates.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200 thousand units signal weakening residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
